title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — November 10, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.9 (Peaked November 10, 2026 at 14:07 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 601 km/s (Fast)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.33)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

The solar wind is in a hurry today. 💨🌌👀

Several bright active regions and a compact sunspot group are currently visible on the Sun.

Images: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195, 284, 171, 304, 131, 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
